pr_title: lightning: job range keys and region split keys are 2 concepts (part 2)
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #55374 

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

1. common.Engine interface has changed. Now it doesn't have a region split size parameter. Implementations can choose split keys or range keys when constructed, or set the region split size parameter as a member.
2. LoadIngestData now returns multiple ranges instead of one range. These ranges should be considered with actual regions in cluster and convereted to regionJob
3. LoadIngestData now return data and ranges based on implementation's internal information rather than arguments. For example, for external engine it will use jobKeys.

issue_context.body:

2、run import into

comments:
The reason is tikv's default region size is larger than 96MB after https://github.com/tikv/tikv/pull/17311, and we hardcoded some calculations which assume the region size.

![f3366cfe-c61e-402a-b54c-49733dec5cbf](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f3f86d0-cb7c-4f69-a6f9-51708267f58b)

So IMPORT INTO generates large tasks and can't allocate the memory for it.
Mark affects-8.1 because user may manually changed the region parameters in old versions
close it because cherry-pick to 8.1.2 is done
